rootCause: The Quote Authority contract source existed and source QA passed, but the immutable Preview package is dependency-closure based. Because canonical index did not reference core/quote-authority-contract-v1.js, Hosting rewrote the missing path to index.html, yielding HTTP 200 without the contract version marker.
remediation: Add one canonical index script reference for quote-authority-contract-v1.js. This makes the pure contract reachable/hosted; it does not enable provider transport, call providers, mutate data, or authorize live.
